task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: The robot navigates to the CUP, picks it up, navigates to the TABLE, and places the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: The robot can move directly to the CUP and TABLE without obstacles.
The coordinates of the objects remain unchanged before the robot interacts with them.
rtdl: def task pick_and_place(;){ state nav1_success: bool; state nav1_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav2_success: bool; state nav2_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav1_success, message->nav1_msg); check(nav1_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP"; success->pick_success, message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=-2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav2_success, message->nav2_msg); check(nav2_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP", location_name="TABLE"; success->place_success, message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
